meta.description: Vitrasa (Vigo, Spain) urban bus network: lines, ordered stops per line and overlapping stops. Deterministic dump (no timestamps) intended for git versioning.
meta.line_definition: lines are GTFS route_short_name values, whitespace-stripped; duplicated route_ids (e.g. '15A' and '15A.') are merged under the same line.

realtime_api.returns: estimaciones[] with minutos / ruta / linea / metros and parada[] with stop name + coords

realtime_estimations_api.note: realtime_id is embedded in the GTFS stop_code (P0014135 -> 14135)
realtime_estimations_api.returns: next arrivals per stop: minutes, route headsign, line, meters from stop

meta.stop_sequence_rule: per direction: stop sequence of the trip with the most stops; ties broken by smallest trip_id
